import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def satisfies_red_props (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r =>
    satisfies_red_props l ∧
    satisfies_red_props r ∧
    -- Rule: No Right-Leaning Red
    (¬ is_red r) ∧
    -- Rule: No Double Red on Left (left child red AND left.left child red)
    (match l with
     | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => ¬ is_red ll
     | _ => True)

-- Main Invariant
def is_llrbt (t : Node) : Prop :=
  is_bst t ∧
  black_height t ≠ -1 ∧
  satisfies_red_props t

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_llrbt t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def sizeN : Node → Nat
  | Node.Empty => 0
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r => sizeN l + sizeN r + 1

def isEmptyN : Node → Bool
  | Node.Empty => true
  | _ => false

def left_of : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => l
  | _ => Node.Empty

def right_of : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => r
  | _ => Node.Empty

def key_of : Node → Int
  | Node.Tree _ v _ _ => v
  | _ => 0

def with_left (t : Node) (l : Node) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c v _ r => Node.Tree c v l r
  | _ => t

def with_right (t : Node) (r : Node) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c v l _ => Node.Tree c v l r
  | _ => t

def with_key (t : Node) (x : Int) : Node :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree c _ l r => Node.Tree c x l r
  | _ => t

def redden : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => Node.Tree Color.Red v l r
  | _ => Node.Empty

def blacken : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => Node.Tree Color.Black v l r
  | _ => Node.Empty

def flipColor : Color → Color
  | Color.Red => Color.Black
  | Color.Black => Color.Red

def flipColors : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree cl lv ll lr) (Node.Tree cr rv rl rr) =>
      Node.Tree (flipColor c) v
        (Node.Tree (flipColor cl) lv ll lr)
        (Node.Tree (flipColor cr) rv rl rr)
  | t => t

def rotateLeft : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v l (Node.Tree _ rv rl rr) =>
      Node.Tree c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr
  | t => t

def rotateRight : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c v (Node.Tree _ lv ll lr) r =>
      Node.Tree c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r)
  | t => t

def fixUp (t : Node) : Node :=
  let t1 := if is_red (right_of t) && !is_red (left_of t) then rotateLeft t else t
  let t2 := if is_red (left_of t1) && is_red (left_of (left_of t1)) then rotateRight t1 else t1
  if is_red (left_of t2) && is_red (right_of t2) then flipColors t2 else t2

def moveRedLeft (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (left_of (right_of (flipColors t))) then
    flipColors (rotateLeft (with_right (flipColors t) (rotateRight (right_of (flipColors t)))))
  else flipColors t

def moveRedRight (t : Node) : Node :=
  if is_red (left_of (left_of (flipColors t))) then flipColors (rotateRight (flipColors t))
  else flipColors t

def minKey : Node → Int
  | Node.Tree _ v Node.Empty _ => v
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => minKey l
  | Node.Empty => 0

def deleteMin : Nat → Node → Node
  | 0, t => t
  | _ + 1, Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | _ + 1, Node.Tree _ _ Node.Empty _ => Node.Empty
  | f + 1, t =>
      let t1 :=
        if !is_red (left_of t) && !is_red (left_of (left_of t)) then moveRedLeft t else t
      fixUp (with_left t1 (deleteMin f (left_of t1)))

def del : Nat → Node → Int → Node
  | 0, t, _ => t
  | _ + 1, Node.Empty, _ => Node.Empty
  | f + 1, t, v =>
      if v < key_of t then
        let t1 :=
          if !is_red (left_of t) && !is_red (left_of (left_of t)) then moveRedLeft t else t
        fixUp (with_left t1 (del f (left_of t1) v))
      else
        let t1 := if is_red (left_of t) then rotateRight t else t
        if v = key_of t1 && isEmptyN (right_of t1) then Node.Empty
        else
          let t2 :=
            if !is_red (right_of t1) && !is_red (left_of (right_of t1)) then moveRedRight t1
            else t1
          if v = key_of t2 then
            fixUp (with_right (with_key t2 (minKey (right_of t2))) (deleteMin f (right_of t2)))
          else fixUp (with_right t2 (del f (right_of t2) v))
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ l r =>
      let t0 := if !is_red l && !is_red r then redden t else t
      blacken (del (sizeN t + 1) t0 v)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : Node) (v : Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : delete_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_llrbt result ∧
  view result = view t \ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
@[simp] lemma view_empty : view Node.Empty = (∅ : Set Int) := rfl

@[simp] lemma view_tree (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node) :
    view (Node.Tree c x l r) = view l ∪ view r ∪ {x} := rfl

@[simp] lemma view_redden (t : Node) : view (redden t) = view t := by
  cases t <;> simp [redden]

@[simp] lemma view_blacken (t : Node) : view (blacken t) = view t := by
  cases t <;> simp [blacken]

@[simp] lemma view_flipColors (t : Node) : view (flipColors t) = view t := by
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x Node.Empty r => cases r <;> rfl
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree _ _ _ _) Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree _ _ _ _) (Node.Tree _ _ _ _) => simp [flipColors]

@[simp] lemma view_rotateLeft (t : Node) : view (rotateLeft t) = view t := by
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x l Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x l (Node.Tree _ rv rl rr) =>
      simp only [rotateLeft, view_tree]
      ext y; simp; tauto

@[simp] lemma view_rotateRight (t : Node) : view (rotateRight t) = view t := by
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x Node.Empty r => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree _ lv ll lr) r =>
      simp only [rotateRight, view_tree]
      ext y; simp; tauto

lemma view_with_left (t l' : Node) (h : view l' = view (left_of t)) :
    view (with_left t l') = view t := by
  cases t <;> simp_all [with_left, left_of]

lemma view_with_right (t r' : Node) (h : view r' = view (right_of t)) :
    view (with_right t r') = view t := by
  cases t <;> simp_all [with_right, right_of]

@[simp] lemma view_fixUp (t : Node) : view (fixUp t) = view t := by
  simp only [fixUp, apply_ite view, view_rotateLeft, view_rotateRight,
    view_flipColors, ite_self]

@[simp] lemma view_moveRedLeft (t : Node) : view (moveRedLeft t) = view t := by
  unfold moveRedLeft
  split_ifs
  · rw [view_flipColors, view_rotateLeft,
        view_with_right _ _ (view_rotateRight _), view_flipColors]
  · exact view_flipColors t

@[simp] lemma view_moveRedRight (t : Node) : view (moveRedRight t) = view t := by
  unfold moveRedRight
  split_ifs
  · rw [view_flipColors, view_rotateRight, view_flipColors]
  · exact view_flipColors t

/-! ### Color `BEq` reduction (derived `BEq` does not `simp` on its own) -/

@[simp] lemma beq_black_black : (Color.Black == Color.Black) = true := rfl
@[simp] lemma beq_red_black : (Color.Red == Color.Black) = false := rfl

/-! ### `black_height` plumbing -/

lemma bh_pos : ∀ t : Node, black_height t ≠ -1 → 1 ≤ black_height t := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | Empty => intro _; simp [black_height]
  | Tree c x l r ihl ihr =>
    intro h
    simp only [black_height] at h ⊢
    by_cases hc : black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r
    · rw [if_pos hc] at h ⊢
      have hl := ihl hc.1
      split_ifs <;> omega
    · rw [if_neg hc] at h; exact absurd rfl h

lemma bh_blacken (t : Node) (h : black_height t ≠ -1) :
    black_height (blacken t) ≠ -1 := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => simp [blacken, black_height]
  | Tree c x l r =>
    simp only [blacken, black_height] at h ⊢
    by_cases hc : black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r
    · rw [if_pos hc]
      have hl := bh_pos l hc.1
      simp only [beq_black_black, if_true]
      omega
    · rw [if_neg hc] at h; exact absurd rfl h

lemma bh_redden (t : Node) (h : black_height t ≠ -1) :
    black_height (redden t) ≠ -1 := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => simp [redden, black_height]
  | Tree c x l r =>
    simp only [redden, black_height] at h ⊢
    by_cases hc : black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r
    · rw [if_pos hc] at h ⊢
      simpa using hc.1
    · rw [if_neg hc] at h; exact absurd rfl h

/-- Destructor: a valid black height at a `Tree` forces both children valid and equal. -/
lemma bh_tree_ne (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) ≠ -1) :
    black_height l ≠ -1 ∧ black_height r ≠ -1 ∧ black_height l = black_height r := by
  simp only [black_height] at h
  by_contra hc
  rw [if_neg hc] at h
  exact h rfl

/-- Builder: the value of `black_height` at a `Tree` with valid, equal children. -/
lemma bh_tree_mk (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (hl : black_height l ≠ -1) (hr : black_height r ≠ -1)
    (he : black_height l = black_height r) :
    black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) =
      if c == Color.Black then black_height l + 1 else black_height l := by
  simp only [black_height]
  rw [if_pos ⟨hl, hr, he⟩]

/-- `rotateLeft` preserves black height when the right child is red. -/
lemma bh_rotateLeft (t : Node) (hred : is_red (right_of t) = true)
    (h : black_height t ≠ -1) :
    black_height (rotateLeft t) = black_height t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => simp [right_of, is_red] at hred
  | Tree c v l r =>
    cases r with
    | Empty => simp [right_of, is_red] at hred
    | Tree cr rv rl rr =>
      cases cr with
      | Black => simp [right_of, is_red] at hred
      | Red =>
        obtain ⟨hl1, hr1, he1⟩ := bh_tree_ne c v l _ h
        obtain ⟨hl2, hr2, he2⟩ := bh_tree_ne Color.Red rv rl rr hr1
        have hEq : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red rv rl rr) = black_height rl := by
          rw [bh_tree_mk Color.Red rv rl rr hl2 hr2 he2]; simp
        have hnew : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) = black_height l := by
          rw [bh_tree_mk Color.Red v l rl hl1 hl2 (by omega)]; simp
        simp only [rotateLeft]
        rw [bh_tree_mk c rv (Node.Tree Color.Red v l rl) rr (by omega) hr2 (by omega),
            bh_tree_mk c v l _ hl1 hr1 he1, hnew]

/-- `rotateRight` preserves black height when the left child is red. -/
lemma bh_rotateRight (t : Node) (hred : is_red (left_of t) = true)
    (h : black_height t ≠ -1) :
    black_height (rotateRight t) = black_height t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => simp [left_of, is_red] at hred
  | Tree c v l r =>
    cases l with
    | Empty => simp [left_of, is_red] at hred
    | Tree cl lv ll lr =>
      cases cl with
      | Black => simp [left_of, is_red] at hred
      | Red =>
        obtain ⟨hl1, hr1, he1⟩ := bh_tree_ne c v _ r h
        obtain ⟨hl2, hr2, he2⟩ := bh_tree_ne Color.Red lv ll lr hl1
        have hEq : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red lv ll lr) = black_height ll := by
          rw [bh_tree_mk Color.Red lv ll lr hl2 hr2 he2]; simp
        have hnew : black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r) = black_height lr := by
          rw [bh_tree_mk Color.Red v lr r hr2 hr1 (by omega)]; simp
        simp only [rotateRight]
        rw [bh_tree_mk c lv ll (Node.Tree Color.Red v lr r) hl2 (by omega) (by omega),
            bh_tree_mk c v _ r hl1 hr1 he1, hEq]

/-! ### `is_bst` / `satisfies_red_props` are colour-agnostic at the root -/

lemma bst_blacken (t : Node) (h : is_bst t) : is_bst (blacken t) := by
  cases t <;> exact h

lemma bst_redden (t : Node) (h : is_bst t) : is_bst (redden t) := by
  cases t <;> exact h

lemma red_props_blacken (t : Node) (h : satisfies_red_props t) :
    satisfies_red_props (blacken t) := by
  cases t <;> exact h

lemma red_props_redden (t : Node) (h : satisfies_red_props t) :
    satisfies_red_props (redden t) := by
  cases t <;> exact h

lemma llrbt_blacken (t : Node) (h : is_llrbt t) : is_llrbt (blacken t) :=
  ⟨bst_blacken t h.1, bh_blacken t h.2.1, red_props_blacken t h.2.2⟩

lemma llrbt_redden (t : Node) (h : is_llrbt t) : is_llrbt (redden t) :=
  ⟨bst_redden t h.1, bh_redden t h.2.1, red_props_redden t h.2.2⟩

/-! ### `sizeN` invariance of the O(1) rebalancers (fuel accounting) -/

@[simp] lemma sizeN_redden (t : Node) : sizeN (redden t) = sizeN t := by
  cases t <;> simp [redden, sizeN]

@[simp] lemma sizeN_blacken (t : Node) : sizeN (blacken t) = sizeN t := by
  cases t <;> simp [blacken, sizeN]

@[simp] lemma sizeN_flipColors (t : Node) : sizeN (flipColors t) = sizeN t := by
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x Node.Empty r => cases r <;> rfl
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree _ _ _ _) Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree _ _ _ _) (Node.Tree _ _ _ _) => simp [flipColors, sizeN]

@[simp] lemma sizeN_rotateLeft (t : Node) : sizeN (rotateLeft t) = sizeN t := by
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x l Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x l (Node.Tree _ rv rl rr) => simp [rotateLeft, sizeN]; omega

@[simp] lemma sizeN_rotateRight (t : Node) : sizeN (rotateRight t) = sizeN t := by
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x Node.Empty r => rfl
  | Node.Tree c x (Node.Tree _ lv ll lr) r => simp [rotateRight, sizeN]; omega

@[simp] lemma sizeN_with_left (t l' : Node) (h : sizeN l' = sizeN (left_of t)) :
    sizeN (with_left t l') = sizeN t := by
  cases t <;> simp_all [with_left, left_of, sizeN]

@[simp] lemma sizeN_with_right (t r' : Node) (h : sizeN r' = sizeN (right_of t)) :
    sizeN (with_right t r') = sizeN t := by
  cases t <;> simp_all [with_right, right_of, sizeN]

@[simp] lemma sizeN_with_key (t : Node) (x : Int) : sizeN (with_key t x) = sizeN t := by
  cases t <;> simp [with_key, sizeN]

@[simp] lemma sizeN_fixUp (t : Node) : sizeN (fixUp t) = sizeN t := by
  simp only [fixUp, apply_ite sizeN, sizeN_rotateLeft, sizeN_rotateRight,
    sizeN_flipColors, ite_self]

@[simp] lemma sizeN_moveRedLeft (t : Node) : sizeN (moveRedLeft t) = sizeN t := by
  unfold moveRedLeft
  split_ifs
  · rw [sizeN_flipColors, sizeN_rotateLeft,
        sizeN_with_right _ _ (sizeN_rotateRight _), sizeN_flipColors]
  · exact sizeN_flipColors t

@[simp] lemma sizeN_moveRedRight (t : Node) : sizeN (moveRedRight t) = sizeN t := by
  unfold moveRedRight
  split_ifs
  · rw [sizeN_flipColors, sizeN_rotateRight, sizeN_flipColors]
  · exact sizeN_flipColors t
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem delete_postcond_satisfied (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t) :
    delete_postcond t v (delete t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty => simp [delete, view, is_llrbt, is_bst, black_height, satisfies_red_props]
  | Tree c x l r => simp [delete]
  -- !benchmark @end proof
